title: Peter B Probable NDE 7363
content: I had a 105 fever for three days. It was the Flu. I had been sick for a long time and just asked God if it was his will to take me. I said, 'into your hands I commend my spirit'. I had a wall clock in my bedroom it stopped and so it seemed did my breathing. I had a feeling for a brief time of numbness. There was a feeling of lonesomeness and the room seemed to fill with a fog. It was then I had a feeling of floating and like a fainting feeling. In a flash, I was not in my bed any longer. Looking up, I saw the clouds. Then I looked back to see my person body lying there on the bed. I could feel uplift and no longer felt the weight of this world. I was free and now flying into the clouds. There was no more pain, no more anything of this earth. Looking ahead, I was going higher and then there was a bright warm light, so bright but full of love. There was no fear at all. I came to a stop. Suddenly, from no place at all, there was a voice. It was a warm and soft voice that said, 'You have to go back, it is not your time you have things to finish that are not done!' BOOM I began to fall like on a roller coaster. I could feel weight coming back, fear, and anger all at the same time. Then there was numbness. I could hear the clock ticking again. I opened my eyes and I was back in my bed and the fever was gone: it was as if I was never sick.

out_of_body.separation_sensations_other: Brief numbness; lonesomeness; room filled with fog; floating/fainting feeling; felt uplift and 'no longer felt the weight of this world.'

arrival.other_being_detail: A warm, soft voice appeared 'from no place at all' and told him to return.

environment.environment_other_detail: Clouds; fog filling the room before separation.

boundary_and_return.mission_detail: Told: 'You have things to finish that are not done!'

context.nde_cause_other_detail: Flu with 105 fever for three days.

stage_sequence.elements_other_detail: Fog-filled room and numbness before separation; flying into clouds; command to return; falling sensation back into body; clock stopped then resumed ticking.
stage_sequence.sequence_variation_description: OBE with ascent into clouds, then bright loving light, then a voice instructing return, followed by rapid falling back into body.

unique_elements.nonstandard_elements: Wall clock in bedroom stopped as breathing seemed to stop; upon return he heard the clock ticking again and the fever was gone 'as if I was never sick.'
unique_elements.notable_quotes: 'into your hands I commend my spirit' ; 'You have to go back, it is not your time you have things to finish that are not done!'
